## What this does

Plumbing, not part of the method itself. An occurrence record is really a
triple — e.g. (site, species, time period), or (neighbour site, target
site, weight) — and `frescalo`/`neighsim` sort huge numbers of these
triples so that matching records end up adjacent (all records for one
site together, sorted by species; all a target site's weighted neighbours
together, etc.). `make_rec30` glues three 10-character fields into one
30-character record so they sort and compare as a single unit;
`rec30_field` pulls one of the three fields back out again.

### `make_rec30`

```{.rust filename="src/lib.rs" tangle="lib__make_rec30"}
pub fn make_rec30(a: &Name, b: &Name, c: &Name) -> Rec30 {
    let mut r = [BLANK; 30];
    r[0..10].copy_from_slice(a);
    r[10..20].copy_from_slice(b);
    r[20..30].copy_from_slice(c);
    r
}
```

### `rec30_field`

```{.rust filename="src/lib.rs" tangle="lib__rec30_field"}
pub fn rec30_field(r: &Rec30, i: usize) -> Name {
    let mut n = [BLANK; 10];
    n.copy_from_slice(&r[i * 10..i * 10 + 10]);
    n
}
```
